message.content: In one of the discussions, GromHellscream suggests adding lanterns or string lights to the garden to brighten the area in the evening. GromHellscream believes that such lighting would give the garden a cozy atmosphere during the evenings, suitable for community gatherings. Additionally, GromHellscream suggests incorporating solar-powered lanterns, which are described as eco-friendly and providing a lovely soft glow without any wiring hassles. Furthermore, GromHellscream mentions that solar-powered lanterns can charge during the day while the garden is being worked on, indicating that these lanterns could be an efficient solution for evening illumination.
